newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to last week's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 55.00-61.00; 700-800 lbs 54.50-61.00; 800-900 lbs few 55.00-58.50. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs 48.00-53.00. Holstein Large 2 750-850 lbs few 37.50-38.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 50.00-57.00; 700-800 lbs 49.00-56.00. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs 44.00-49.50. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 3,000.
